units.source_text: 两夜的黑暗中，金阁朦朦胧胧，其轮廓恍惚不定。

en.t: In the darkness of those two nights, the Golden Pavilion appeared dim and hazy, its outline wavering uncertainly.

units.source_text: 它漆黑地屹立着，简直像是黑夜的结晶体。

en.t: It stood there in pitch-black darkness, almost like a crystal formed from the night itself.

units.source_text: 定睛凝望，勉强可见三楼的究竟顶忽然变细的结构、法水院和潮音洞的细长的桂林。

en.t: When I fixed my eyes on it, I could just barely make out the structure where the third story's Kukyocho roof suddenly narrowed, and the slender pillars of the Hosui-in and Choon-do.

units.source_text: 这些昔日曾使我那样深受感动的细部，如今全然融化在一色的漆黑之中。

en.t: Those details that had once moved me so deeply were now completely dissolved into a single expanse of jet-black darkness.
